description: This file is a React-Redux component for managing and displaying a list of channels related to data retention policies in the Mattermost application. It connects the ChannelList component to the Redux store, handling search, filtering, and policy-specific channel retrieval.

methods.name: searchChannelsToAdd
methods.description: Filters and maps channels based on search term and filters to prepare a list of channels to add.

methods.name: mapStateToProps
methods.description: Maps Redux state and component props to the component's props, handling channel filtering and policy data.

methods.name: mapDispatchToProps
methods.description: Binds action creators to dispatch for use in the component.
